title: Model-to-Data Distillation for Graph Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2605.06814v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) increasingly rely on sophisticated architectures and training procedures to achieve desirable properties such as high predictive performance, fairness, and robustness. However, these properties typically remain tied to the models that learn them, limiting their transferability to simpler models and downstream settings. We introduce model-to-data (M2D) distillation, a new distillation paradigm that transfers properties learned by a complex GNN teacher into graph data, enabling simpler models to recover them through standard training. M2D distillation explicitly trades model complexity for data complexity by jointly learning augmented node features and graph structure that encode the teacher's behavior. The resulting graph serves as a persistent medium for knowledge transfer and can be used with different downstream models. tldr: 提出模型到数据（M2D）蒸馏这一新范式，通过联合学习增强节点特征和图结构，将复杂GNN教师模型的预测性能、公平性、鲁棒性等特性蒸馏到图数据中，使简单模型仅需标准训练即可获得这些特性。
